# json/default@1 samples

Source: RFC 8259, section 13 "Examples" (<https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8259#section-13>): the
`Image` object and the array of two locations. The `.in` files are the RFC's text (three-space
indentation, aligned values). The `.out` files are the same data in the layout of `json/default`
(two spaces); the RFC prescribes no layout, so this is not the RFC's whitespace.
